steps.body: A drawing keeps a group still so you can count it carefully.
steps.narration: A drawing keeps a group still so you can count it carefully.

widget.prompt: Draw 2 circles, then 4 more. Show the total on the frame.

commonCounts.feedback: That counts only the first drawing. The 4 new circles count too.

widget.missFeedback: Fill one square at a time, counting as you go, until the frame shows the number you need.
widget.successFeedback: Six filled — 2 circles and 4 more make 6.

predict.prompt: You draw 2 circles, then draw 4 more. How many circles are on the page?
predict.reveal: Every circle on the page counts, whether you drew it first or second: 6 in all. Picking 4 counts only what you added and forgets the 2 already on the page.

misconceptions: Changing a visible feature without preserving the relationship that defines koa drawings.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the model stop representing the same mathematical relationship?

explanationVariants: Every circle on the page counts.
